summary: Pole tower with L-4 cab built 1933 east of Mullan, Idaho; removed or destroyed in 1955; Interstate 90 now runs through the site.

facts.status_note: Removed or destroyed in 1955; firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say Interstate 90 now runs through the spot.

visit.trail_note: No source describes a visitor approach or any access rule; Interstate 90 now covers the spot (firelookout.com; Idaho Fire Lookouts).

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts give 25 feet; the Weebly list gives 30 feet. The story reports the disagreement and gives no figure; height_m is left out.
firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say removed in 1955; the Weebly list says destroyed that year. The story reports both wordings.

notes_for_editor: Height disputed (25 vs 30 ft) and the 1955 fate is worded differently across sources; the story reports both. Staffing names come from Idaho Fire Lookouts' citations to Wallace Press-Times and Kellogg Evening News; the newspapers were not read directly. Idaho Fire Lookouts' header says Destroyed while its history says Removed; the story follows the history. The 1953 picnic-area plan is from the Weebly page's quotation of the Spokesman-Review; no source says whether a picnic area exists today. The existing 1938 photo in the record (idahofirelookouts.com) is kept; no new photos added. Correction (2026-10-10): Idaho Fire Lookouts lists George Adams for 1937 and George D Howard for 1946. An earlier draft put Howard in 1937; the record and story were corrected.
